content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge is resolving a collision over Matthew 1:20 between the challenger's DR3 answer and the defender's CR2/CR3 answers, so K-C governs how that collision must be weighed.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse","room":"weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: one reading requires comparing the footing of each side's chain; the other permits an underdetermined label merely because each side offered an answer.","why":"The judge declares the point underdetermined merely because each side has an answer, without comparing the footing of the DR3 chain against the CR2/CR3 chains as K-C requires."}
